you_should_know.title: Mike Lindell responds after being accused of violating campaign law
you_should_know.summary: Minnesota GOP candidate for governor Mike Lindell says he's being wrongly attacked for tossing pillows at parades. A complaint says he's breaking something called the Twinkie law — a Minnesota law limiting free giveaways to influence voters. Esme Murphy listened to a hearing Monday in connection with the accusation.
